description.en:
KAI is Kinetix AI's full-size humanoid concept within its embodied-intelligence program. Its development direction emphasizes humanlike form, interaction and learning, combining the physical robot with models intended to support motion and reasoning.

The manufacturer presents possible applications across homes, factories, restaurants and shops. These describe the intended breadth of the platform, rather than a verified list of production-ready functions. Public material currently provides limited differentiation between KAI and the KAI Bot naming, so version-specific dimensions, payload and task performance require confirmation before comparison.
